storyCards.headline: Passion: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Rod Stewart's "Passion" reached #5 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Passion" is a song by Rod Stewart that first appeared in 1980 on his album Foolish Behaviour.

It was the lead single and biggest hit from the album, reaching number five on the US Billboard Hot 100, number two in Canada, and a sizeable hit across Europe.

The song was also released as a 12-inch promotional single with an extended running time of 7:30.

The song peaked at #5 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 20 weeks on the chart.
